name: Gabe
text: Mike went down? The guy who never saves his files?

name: Gabe
text: Name's Gabe. I work at the Apple Store. I'm a Genius. It says so on the badge.

name: Gabe
text: Parked across three spaces to get here, too.

name: Gabe
text: Like the great Dunkey says: [color=#ffaa40]"It's a masterpiece! I'm a genius!"[/color]
